milestones.title: Planning baseline
acceptance: Engineering strategy, architecture, release gates and staffing assumptions are internally consistent.
Repository validation and its negative contract tests pass.
Public repository contains the reviewed planning baseline, without engine completion claims.

milestones.title: Deterministic offline renderer
acceptance: Freeze the complete M1 scope and upstream fixture IDs before implementation review.
All frozen M1 assertions and reftests pass through the custom parser-to-pixel pipeline.
Each fixture repeats 100 times with identical pixels on the pinned environment and reproduces on a second equivalent worker.
Seven consecutive days of parser and layout fuzzing have no unresolved reproducible crash; size and time limits pass.
Network and script execution remain disabled.

milestones.title: Sandboxed network browser
acceptance: Frozen navigation, Fetch, TLS, origin, cookie and cache tests pass.
Compromised-child and hostile IPC tests prove denied ambient file and socket access.
Codec isolation, cancellation, process teardown and unrelated-tab crash recovery pass.
Independent security review has no open critical or high findings before arbitrary network browsing.
Controlled internal test builds only; external network-capable distribution additionally requires the applicable B042 operational release gates.

milestones.title: JavaScript and dynamic web platform
acceptance: Approved VM embedding decision includes GC ownership and update rehearsal evidence.
Real Web IDL bindings, realms, event loop, microtasks, modules, mutation and document lifecycle pass declared tests.
Embedded Test262 results have no unexplained regression against the identical standalone VM build.
Script-enabled cross-origin and lifecycle adversarial tests pass.
Controlled internal test builds only; external network-capable distribution additionally requires the applicable B042 operational release gates.

milestones.title: Developer alpha
acceptance: Published flex/grid, forms/editing, international text, accessibility, inspector and WebDriver alpha matrix passes.
At least 90 percent of the frozen 100-task corpus succeeds.
Thirty-day supervised use has no unresolved critical or high security defect or profile corruption.
Signed install, update, rollback and vulnerability intake drills pass.

milestones.title: Competitive readiness
acceptance: At least 99 percent of the frozen advertised-feature WPT cohort passes and whole-suite outcome counts are published.
At least 98 percent of the frozen 500-task corpus succeeds.
Independent isolation, VM and update review passes with no open critical or high security finding; 90-day operations drill passes.
Declared accessibility and controlled latency, memory and product-advantage thresholds in docs/ROADMAP.md pass.
Each supported platform has staffed ownership, patch capacity and reproducible release evidence.

tasks.title: Publish the verified engineering baseline
acceptance: Publish coherent planning documents and explicit implementation status.
Pass repository checks and record exact commands, environment and results.

tasks.title: Freeze the M1 capability and fixture contract
acceptance: List exact HTML/CSS/text/paint features, spec sections, upstream revisions and expected outcomes.
Include malformed and boundary cases, input/memory/time limits, pinned fonts and image assets with licenses.

tasks.title: Bootstrap reproducible Rust builds and a real executable slice
acceptance: Pin the toolchain and dependency locks; build from clean Linux workers and a macOS developer host.
CLI reads a constrained input and writes a validated document artifact through real parsing code; no empty subsystem crates.

tasks.title: Implement the HTML tokenizer cohort
acceptance: Match the frozen token fixtures including character references, raw-text states and malformed input.
Bound input growth and document tokenizer errors; run fuzz target with reproducible failures retained.

tasks.title: Implement DOM ownership and HTML tree construction
acceptance: Pass document and fragment tree fixtures including malformed nesting and node/attribute handling.
Test identity, ownership, mutation invariants, deep inputs and deterministic teardown.

tasks.title: Implement CSS syntax, selectors and cascade
acceptance: Pass cohort tokenization, declaration recovery, type/class/ID/combinator selectors, origins, specificity and source order.
Computed values, inheritance and box-model inputs have assertion tests rather than screenshot-only tests.

tasks.title: Integrate deterministic international text metrics
acceptance: Shape Latin, Arabic and Devanagari fixtures using licensed pinned fonts and explicit Unicode data.
Pass direction, cluster, wrapping and malformed-font limits; document native ownership and dependency updates.

tasks.title: Implement block and inline formatting
acceptance: Pass frozen geometry tests for sizing, margins, padding, borders, whitespace and line wrapping.
Cover nested/empty/oversized documents and deterministic bounded failure without hidden truncation.

tasks.title: Implement display lists, PNG resources and CPU paint
acceptance: Generate stable display lists and pixels for clipping, text, backgrounds, borders, colors and controlled PNG fixtures.
Validate image decoded-size limits; fail resource manifest escapes and unsupported fixture requirements explicitly.

tasks.title: Deliver the offline fixture runner and inspectable output
acceptance: CLI renders declared inputs to images, layout diagnostics and structured outcomes with reliable exit status.
Runner provides no ambient network or browsing-profile access and preserves stdout/stderr and diff artifacts.

tasks.title: Close the M1 renderer gate with independent replay
acceptance: All M1 assertions pass; each fixture is identical across 100 repetitions and a second equivalent worker.
Seven-day parser/layout fuzz window and resource-limit tests pass; capability matrix includes every unsupported feature.

tasks.title: Implement broker-owned context identity and capability IPC
acceptance: Version and bound messages; bind context/origin/partition authority to broker-owned records.
Reject wrong owner, stale generation, invalid size/offset and mutable shared-memory races; isolate child failure.

tasks.title: Enforce the Linux content and codec sandbox
acceptance: Compose privilege dropping, handle closure, namespaces and syscall/filesystem policy for the chosen Linux baseline.
Hostile children cannot open ambient files/sockets/devices or access another context; startup fails if isolation setup fails.

tasks.title: Implement URL, Fetch, TLS and partitioned network policy
acceptance: Pass pinned URL fixtures plus controlled certificates, redirects, MIME, credentials, CORS, cookies and cache tests.
Broker-authorized requests preserve origin and partition across redirects; enforce cancellation and resource limits.

tasks.title: Deliver navigation, trusted origin UI and storage lifecycle
acceptance: Pass navigation commits, history, stale response, crash recovery and bounded download tests.
Enforce file/internal/opaque origin policy, private-session teardown and quota/partition persistence tests.

tasks.title: Close the network security gate
acceptance: Replay every M2 invariant, including compromised-renderer IPC, cross-context access and isolated decoder attacks.
Fix all critical/high findings and record independent retest before arbitrary public content is enabled.

tasks.title: Select and prove a maintainable JavaScript VM embedding
acceptance: Evaluate SpiderMonkey build/update feasibility and compare alternatives if evidence fails.
Prototype GC-safe wrappers, realm separation, exception propagation, interruption, jobs and modules; record license/build/footprint results.

tasks.title: Implement traced Web IDL and DOM bindings
acceptance: Pass native rooting, cross-language cycle, finalization, reentrancy, conversion and realm identity tests.
No binding outlives its document authority; navigation teardown and GC stress preserve isolation.

tasks.title: Integrate the HTML event loop and dynamic rendering
acceptance: Pass tasks, microtask checkpoints, timers, promises, events, module loading and script loading order fixtures.
DOM mutation invalidates affected style/layout and paints correct pixels; runaway work can be interrupted.

tasks.title: Close the dynamic platform compatibility gate
acceptance: Run real Test262 standalone and embedded adapters with upstream flags, negative tests, async and module semantics.
Publish both denominators with no unexplained embedding regression; script-enabled origin and lifecycle security tests pass.

tasks.title: Expand layout, forms, editing and international interaction
acceptance: Pass full declared alpha flex/grid and positioning cohorts with geometry and reference tests.
Pass selection, focus, keyboard, forms, IME, bidirectional text and complex-script editing task fixtures.

tasks.title: Deliver accessibility, inspector and WebDriver integration
acceptance: Expose tested semantic tree, focus and actions to the supported OS accessibility bridge.
Human screen-reader and keyboard tasks pass; inspector reports real DOM/styles/layout and WebDriver runs WPT through a real adapter.

tasks.title: Establish signed release, update and incident operations
acceptance: Test authenticated updates, rollback authorization, tampered metadata rejection, interruption and recovery.
Rehearse private intake, dependency patching, signing-key separation and profile migration with staffed backup owners.

tasks.title: Close the developer alpha gate
acceptance: Pass at least 90 percent of frozen 100-site tasks, with every failure and unsupported capability visible.
Complete thirty-day supervised trial without unresolved critical/high security findings or profile corruption.

tasks.title: Broaden standards, site compatibility and platform coverage
acceptance: Freeze release scope covering all tests for advertised features and publish full WPT manifest outcome counts.
Reach at least 99 percent scoped WPT and 98 percent of frozen 500-site tasks; ports satisfy their own isolation and accessibility gates.

tasks.title: Demonstrate competitive performance with reproducible controls
acceptance: Use matched stable Chromium/Firefox versions and full process-tree memory with correctness/security enabled.
Pass predeclared latency, memory and product-advantage thresholds with raw samples and uncertainty from two workers.

tasks.title: Complete independent release security and continuity review
acceptance: Retest sandbox, VM, origin, update and accessibility gates with no critical/high finding open.
Complete the 90-day patch/incident drill and verify two maintainers for each critical subsystem before release approval.
